pages.title: Paradox Residue
pages.text: What is left behind after a contradiction resolves itself. When reality is forced to hold two incompatible facts, something has to give, and this grey, flaky ash is what gives. It has a habit of being in my pocket before I put it there, and gone shortly after I take it out.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)Breaking an Axiom Fragment with Dark Energy in the Axiomatic Breach Engine, I expected nothing to survive. Something did: a residue of the broken rule. Paradox Echoes leave the same ash wherever they fade.
